declaration.declared_before: F0_RESULT_EXECUTION: no F0 feature value, label, return, MFE/MAE, baseline, bucket, hypothesis result, bootstrap or tail statistic had been computed or read
declaration.question: Using only regular-session information of session D (bars starting before 16:00 ET) and daily/reference information through D-1, can the probability of a large same-day after-hours excursion and the expected after-hours return from 16:05 to 17:00 ET be raised meaningfully above the execution-eligible baseline of the same PIT universe?
declaration.promotion_claim: PASS means only 'Strategy F - PROMOTED TO DEVELOPMENT' (next: F-D0..F-D6). It is not an alpha approval, not a trading rule, not an execution or cost claim and not a Paper Trading approval.

frozen_inputs.minute_authority: MASSIVE_TICKER_AGGREGATE adjusted=false, Common Raw provider pages (usb-common-raw-v1), window 04:00-20:00 ET
frozen_inputs.minute_store: Drive 1_US-B market_data/raw/massive/minute (canonical). A local copy (data/runtime/strategy_b_e0/mirror/...) may be read only when every page's sha256 equals the Drive ledger file_sha256; any mismatch is a critical integrity failure.
frozen_inputs.minute_legacy_parquet: NOT_USED (no legacy session lies inside the primary window except for 30 symbols; the primary reads Common Raw only so all symbols share one storage form)
frozen_inputs.daily_reference_split_root: data/runtime/strategy_c/raw (STRATEGY_C_RAW_FREEZE_V1, byte-identical to Drive raw/massive grouped_daily, reference_tickers CS_*, splits_2024-09-16_2026-09-16)
frozen_inputs.panel_loader: app.backtest.strategy_c_selection.panel.load_panel (imported unmodified), allowed exchanges XNAS/XNYS/XASE, split range 2024-09-16..2026-09-16
frozen_inputs.timestamp_convention: bar t = UTC epoch ms of the bar START; converted to America/New_York with zoneinfo; minute-of-day m = hour*60+minute of the bar start
frozen_inputs.network: no Provider API call is allowed in F0

research_window.early_close_rule: any early-close session is excluded from every F0 sample (none exists in the primary window)

long_history_sample.description: the 30 MINUTE_UNIVERSE_V1 symbols with ~2 years (Common Raw + legacy parquet) and the U1 136-symbol cohort
long_history_sample.reason: hindsight-selected large caps / gapped cohort, not a PIT universe

universe.call: for session index d of D in the panel grid: daily_eligibility(D, grid[:d], close=panel.close[:d], volume=panel.volume[:d], factor=F[:d], membership=panel.membership()[d-1], split_in_window=F[d] != F[d-1]) with F = panel.split_arrays()[0] (exactly as app.backtest.strategy_e_r3.build.daily_sessions)

criteria_as_frozen_in_contract.membership: latest quarterly CS snapshot dated <= D-1
criteria_as_frozen_in_contract.information: grouped daily rows through D-1 only; a row dated D or later raises UniverseContractError

ticker_suspect_flag.name: TICKER_SUSPECT
ticker_suspect_flag.rule: set for (symbol, D) when the symbol's composite_figi in the latest CS snapshot dated <= D-1 differs from its composite_figi in the snapshot immediately before that one (both non-null)
ticker_suspect_flag.use: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; rows are not removed; counts and a with/without-flag split are reported

information_cutoff.feature_bar_rule: a session-D bar may enter a feature only if its start minute m satisfies 570 <= m < 960
information_cutoff.prior_session_minute_rule: regular bars (570 <= m < 960) of primary-window sessions strictly before D may enter the RVOL denominator only
information_cutoff.daily_rule: grouped daily rows dated <= D-1 only
forbidden_feature_inputs: bar with m >= 960 on session D (includes the 16:00 bar)
any bar of a session after D
official close of D (grouped daily row of D)
grouped daily/reference/splits dated >= D except the split-execution flag for (D-1, D] used by the universe contract
information_cutoff.bar_1600_classification: POSTMARKET; it carries the closing-auction price and is never a regular feature input

regular_session.regular_close_proxy: close of the bar with m == 959 (15:59)
regular_session.missing_1559_bar: row status FEATURE_INVALID_NO_1559; the row enters neither the baseline nor any H
regular_session.no_substitution: the 16:00 bar open and the official close are never used as the regular close
regular_session.vw_rule: every regular bar of D with v > 0 must carry a finite vw; otherwise status VWAP_UNAVAILABLE and every feature that uses vw is NaN (no fallback price)

features.notation: reg = bars of D with 570 <= m < 960; c1559 = close of bar m=959; DV(S) = sum over bars in S of v*vw; H_reg/L_reg = max high/min low over reg; P(t) = prevailing price at minute t = close of the last reg bar with t-10 <= m < t (NaN if none); prev_close = grouped daily close of D-1 (raw; the universe excludes splits in (D-1, D]); all ratios are simple returns as fractions; NaN inputs give NaN; no imputation

regular_RVOL.formula: regular_dollar_volume(D) / median(regular_dollar_volume(S)) over the most recent up-to-20 primary-window sessions S < D whose regular_dollar_volume is finite and > 0; NaN when fewer than 5 such sessions
regular_RVOL.warmup_note: sessions before the 6th primary session have no RVOL; the denominator never reads minutes before 2026-04-20 for any symbol

close_vs_VWAP.formula: c1559 / VWAP_reg - 1, VWAP_reg = DV(reg) / sum(v over reg)

position_in_day_range.formula: (c1559 - L_reg) / (H_reg - L_reg); NaN when H_reg == L_reg

last15m_return.formula: ALIAS of return_1545_1600 (identical value); reported once in single-feature analysis and marked ALIAS

relative_strength_vs_SPY.formula: day_return(symbol, D) - day_return(SPY, D), SPY computed with the identical formula and cutoff; NaN when SPY's day_return is NaN

features.missing_data_policy: a row with a 15:59 bar is feature-valid; an individual NaN feature makes the row ineligible for every H that reads that feature (counted as FEATURE_MISSING_<name>) but keeps it in the baseline
features.volume_unit: all volume features are dollar volume sum(v*vw)

primary_entry.eligibility: a bar with m == 965 (16:05) exists on D
primary_entry.no_substitution: a later bar (16:06, 16:07, ...) is never used as the primary entry

execution.exit_rule: for target minute T: the bar with the largest m in [T-10, T-1] on D; exit price = its close; none -> UNRESOLVED_EXIT (excluded from that horizon's realized sample); no older bar, no bar at or after T
execution.exit_age_seconds: T*60 - (m_exit + 1)*60 (0 when the exit bar is the T-1 bar); recorded per row

secondary_decision_diagnostic.entry: open of the bar with m == 975; missing -> NO_TRADE

path.MFE: max(high over bars with 965 <= m <= m_exit) / entry - 1
path.MAE: min(low over bars with 965 <= m <= m_exit) / entry - 1
path.note: the path never reads a bar after the exit bar

samples.baseline: every (symbol, D) with D in the primary sessions, symbol eligible under the universe contract, a 15:59 bar, a 16:05 bar and a resolved 17:00 exit
samples.hypothesis_sample: baseline rows whose required features are finite and satisfy every threshold of the H
samples.coverage_report_required: per session and in total: eligible, NO_MINUTE, FEATURE_INVALID_NO_1559, VWAP_UNAVAILABLE, NO_TRADE, UNRESOLVED_EXIT, RESOLVED; exit_age_seconds distribution

hypotheses.comparison: inclusive (>=) on the unrounded float feature
hypotheses.frozen: no threshold is relaxed, tightened or added after any F0 result

single_feature_analysis.buckets: Q1..Q5 pooled over the baseline rows with a finite value; edges = numpy.quantile(values, [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8]) (method 'linear'); bucket = numpy.searchsorted(edges, x, side='right') + 1
single_feature_analysis.edges_from: feature values only; no outcome is read to form edges
single_feature_analysis.monotonicity_report: whether bucket means and P(MFE>=+3%) are monotone over Q1..Q5 and the Q5-Q1 difference
single_feature_analysis.use: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; never used to search or change a threshold

outcome_metrics.return_basis: gross unless a cost scenario is named
outcome_metrics.tail_inclusive: P(x >= k) and P(x <= k) are inclusive

statistical.bootstrap: session-cluster: draw the 104 primary sessions with replacement; each replicate pools every baseline and H row of the drawn sessions (a session drawn k times counts k times)
statistical.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed).integers(0, 104, size=(5000, 104)); the same draw matrix is used for every H and every endpoint
statistical.pass_condition: 99% CI (0.5th percentile) lower bound of tail_lift > 0
also_reported: 95% and 99% CI of mean_lift = mean_H(gross) - mean_base(gross)
statistical.multiplicity_note: the 99% level is the declared strong-evidence standard for five simultaneous hypotheses

tail.relative_lift: P_H / P_base (P_base == 0 -> relative condition passes only if P_H > 0)

downside.ratio_rule: fail if P_H > 1.5 * P_base (with P_base == 0, any P_H > 0 fails)

extreme_removal.ranking: H trades ranked by gross return descending (ties: symbol ascending, then session ascending); only trades with gross return > 0 are removable
extreme_removal.baseline: unchanged (the removed trades also leave the baseline)
extreme_removal.pass_condition: after top1pct removal: mean_lift > 0 and tail_lift(P(MFE>=0.03)) > 0

concentration.basis: per-ticker sum of H net returns at the primary cost scenario (50 bp)
concentration.share: ticker share = its sum / sum of all positive ticker sums; tickers with sum <= 0 have share 0
concentration.leave_top10_tickers: drop the 10 tickers with the largest sums from both H and baseline; aggregate mean_lift (gross) must stay > 0

time_consistency.partition: numpy.array_split of the 104 primary sessions in chronological order (26 each)
time_consistency.empty_block: a block with no H trade counts as not positive

cost.label: cost stress assumption (not a cost estimate: no quote/spread data)

pit.pass_condition: all three pass before any outcome is computed

matched_control.status: REPORTED (not one of the verdict gates); cannot overturn the verdict
matched_control.method: coarsened exact matching, same session only; reuse app.backtest.strategy_e1_h5_confirm.matching conventions (cell ids, match rate, unmatched counted) with F cell variables

median_dollar_volume_20_bucket.source: median(close*volume) of the 20 grouped rows before D (the universe window)

matched_control.edge_semantics: lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive; None = open upper end
matched_control.control_pool: baseline rows of the same session and cell that are not in the H
matched_control.estimand: mean over matched H rows of (H outcome - mean control outcome of its session-cell) for gross return and for 1[MFE>=0.03]; match rate reported
matched_control.diagnostic_matching: a variant adding 16:00-16:04 activity may be reported as DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY

event_diagnostic.source: C-E0 SEC EDGAR submissions store data/runtime/strategy_c/e0/raw (acceptanceDateTime = true UTC, C_E0_RESULTS_V1)
event_diagnostic.ticker_to_cik: cik of the latest CS snapshot dated <= D-1
event_diagnostic.event: EVENT when a form 8-K with item 2.02 of that CIK was accepted in [D-1 16:00 ET, D 17:00 ET)
event_diagnostic.non_event: NON_EVENT only when the CIK is in the store and the store's coverage of that CIK includes D
event_diagnostic.use: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY stratification; never a feature; cannot change the verdict

auction_diagnostic_1600.use: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; never a feature; cannot change a threshold or the verdict

pit_audits.order: PIT audits run on features and H masks before any outcome (entry/exit/return/MFE/MAE) is computed; a failure halts the run with no verdict (fail-closed)

PIT-1.name: FEATURE_CUTOFF_POISON
PIT-1.action: replace every bar with m >= 960 on D and every bar of sessions after D by finite positive noise (seed 2026092711) and add synthetic bars at every empty minute in [960, 1200)
must_be_identical: all regular features (bit-identical, NaN positions equal)

PIT-2.name: DAILY_REFERENCE_POISON
PIT-2.audit_sessions: 12 sessions at indices round(linspace(0, 103, 12)) of the primary list
PIT-2.action: overwrite grouped daily rows dated >= D, reference snapshots dated >= D and split events executing after D (seed 2026092712)

PIT-3.name: SYNTHETIC_LEAK_DETECTION
PIT-3.action: a test-only feature variant that reads the 16:05 bar open inside day_return is run through PIT-1
PIT-3.must: PIT-1 reports a difference; if the planted leak is not detected the audit is invalid and the run halts

critical: page sha256 mismatch against its ledger
invalid OHLC (h < max(o,c,l) or l > min(o,c,h)) or non-positive price in a bar used by F0
integrity.critical_effect: no PASS; verdict INCONCLUSIVE with reason DATA_INTEGRITY

per_hypothesis_order: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE if the sample gate fails
H_PASS if sample, tail, statistical, mean/median, downside, extreme-removal, concentration, time-consistency and cost gates all pass
UNDERPOWERED if every gate except the statistical 99% CI condition passes on point estimates and the 99% CI half-width of tail_lift is >= 0.02
verdict.PASS: at least one H_PASS, PIT-1..3 pass and no critical integrity failure
verdict.INCONCLUSIVE: no H_PASS and (every H is INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, or any H is UNDERPOWERED, or the baseline has fewer than 60 sessions with a resolved row [EXECUTION_RESOLUTION_INSUFFICIENT], or a critical integrity failure)
verdict.FAIL: none of the INCONCLUSIVE conditions holds and no H is H_PASS

promotion.paper_trading: not authorized by F0; considered only after a Trading Backtest PASS

components: minute read-set digest (ledger file_sha256 of every page read)
run_identity.reproduction: two runs with the same identity must produce byte-identical result artifacts

prohibitions: no threshold, window, horizon, cost or gate change after any F0 result
no feature added or removed on the basis of results
no A/E code, signal, runtime or configuration change
